title: Restriction of an integer multiplicity current to an open set
statement: Let P, k ∈ ℕ, let U ⊆ ℝ^P and A ⊆ ℝ^P be open, and let X, R ∈ D_k(U) (GeometricCurrentOn U k) with X integer multiplicity and R a restriction of X to A (IsRestriction X A R). Then R is integer multiplicity.
lean_statement: ∀ (P k : ℕ) (U A : Set (Eucl P)) (X R : GeometricCurrentOn U k), IsOpen U → IsOpen A → IsIntegerMultiplicity X → IsRestriction X A R → IsIntegerMultiplicity R
